text:
Aisha (sales): FYI prospect emailed their infra/network diagram. They want CMK in their VPC + tenant isolation for a multi-tenant app. Can we confirm feasibility for the POC?
Jon (solutions): We can do CMK BYO. Main ask: can the HSM proxy live in their VPC and still meet throughput? Need network/port matrix from them.
Aisha (sales): They attached a diagram and asked about firewall rules. I'm pasting the exact line: "we can only open outbound to a single IP range and need explicit ports"
Ravi (security): For BYO-HSM we support egress-only to our control plane on TLS 443. If they need direct HSM peering, that's a Dedicated/Private case.
Claire (crypto-ops): Throughput note: if they plan >2000 qps of key ops we should bench the proxy. HSMs rate-limit sign/unwrap. What's their expected key lifecycle/rotation cadence?
Aisha (sales): They want daily ephemeral rotations for session KEKs, but monthly for master keys.
Jon (solutions): Daily rotations add load. Recommend using a short-lived wrapping key pattern: master CMK monthly, ephemeral data keys minted per-day via proxy. That minimizes HSM calls.
Ravi (security): Also need audit/logging requirements. Do they require HSM attestation reports or only KMS audit logs?
Aisha (sales): From their questionnaire: "FIPS 140-2/3 HSM attestation, KMIP support, and separation of duties for key ops".
Claire (crypto-ops): Redwood supports HSM-backed CMKs and we can integrate with KMIP-compatible appliances in Private. For hosted POC, we can emulate KMIP but attestation requires customer HSM (BYO) or a certified HSM in Dedicated with SOC reports.
Jon (solutions): Action items for POC: 1) customer to provide allowed IP ranges and firewall rules 2) sample key rotation schedule + qps estimate 3) acceptance criteria (latency p95, successful rotations, audit events).
Aisha (sales): I asked them for the three items and a preferred POC window next week. They asked for a cost estimate if we need Dedicated nodes vs hosted. Can someone give a quick delta?
Claire (crypto-ops): Hosted (proxy to our HSM pool): no infra fee, per-key op cost higher. Dedicated with BYO-HSM: monthly reserved capacity + HSM rental or network peering fees. Ballpark: Dedicated + BYO adds ~ $10-30k/mo depending on GPU/HSM sizing. I'll give a tighter range once they send qps.
Ravi (security): Compliance blockers: if they require customer-managed HSM + on-prem airgap, that's a Private deployment (legal + ent). Need early legal touch.
Jon (solutions): For the POC we can do a staged plan: Stage A hosted integration to validate APIs and rotation logic (no attestation), Stage B Dedicated BYO for performance and attestation tests. That limits upfront cost.
Aisha (sales): Customer asked about rotation automation. Do we support scheduling and dry-run rotations?
Claire (crypto-ops): Yes — we have an API: `POST /v1/keys/:id/rotate?dry_run=true`. Dry runs produce a `rotation.preview` audit event. We'll include sample curl in the runbook.
Jon (solutions): I'll draft a short runbook for them with commands, firewall list, and acceptance test harness (we'll include a simple script to assert `unwrap` latency < 120ms).
Aisha (sales): Perfect. Any blockers from infra/security on opening outbound 443 to Redwood control plane?
Ravi (security): No blocker for 443 egress. If they insist on IP allowlist, we can provide a range. But if they need mutual TLS client certs for extra auth, that's doable for Dedicated.
Aisha (sales): They also asked: "what happens if HSM rotation fails during business hours?"
Claire (crypto-ops): Our rollout policy supports canary + automatic rollback. If a rotation fails, the system falls back to previous wrapping key and emits high-severity alert to ops. We'll include incident playbook steps.
Aisha (sales): Great. I'll summarize to the customer and request the firewall rules + qps + rotation schedule.
deploy-bot: Deployment scheduled: `redwood-proxy-v2` staged snapshot created by jon at 1769001400. :rocket:
Jon (solutions): I'll attach the runbook in the next message and a short cost table once they give qps.
Aisha (sales): Thanks team. If legal needs to join, ping me and I'll loop them in.
Ravi (security): I'll stand by for the audit/attestation checklist.
Claire (crypto-ops): And I'll queue a bench when they provide qps and test vectors.
Aisha (sales): Closing for now — will update thread when customer replies. :white_check_mark:
